review.review:
This was a living-hero planner failure, not an observed death. The initiating contradiction is between descent-only mandatory potion discovery and its starvation prohibition. Magenta was collected before starvation; an intuition stone then rejected the strength hypothesis and was consumed. Exploration and combat continued without a known exit or food. Starvation began at decision 1100, and crimson was subsequently collected while starving. The downstairs first appears in the public state following decision 1136's accepted arrival at 621. At decision 1137 the resource-aware selector requests descent, but mandatory discovery rejects starvation at 33/35 HP. That HP exceeds the 85% health threshold, so the specific impairment is starvation. The typed mandatory-preparation blocker correctly excludes floor abandonment; zero recovery actions were accepted.

Complete source browsing and the full public log resolve the packet's missing inventory, prerequisite and exit-timing context. The terminal inventory supplies neither food nor nonconsumptive identification; its waterskin and mageroyal seed do not resolve hunger. The magenta potion remains unidentified: the failed intuition hypothesis is not permission to assign another effect. Unknown crimson is not confirmed strength. No policy patch or new regression is supplied because no executable safe replacement has been established. A pre-starvation preparation handoff requires validated bank, supply-reservation, inventory-protection and recovery funding, rather than relaxing the drink gate, inventing food or permitting arbitrary exploration after failure. Earlier existing backlog items are retained without claiming they were revalidated here. Offline reconstruction matched original selections 0–1025 before a scratch serialization failure; a retry timed out earlier. Terminal bookkeeping therefore remains unreconstructed, and no alternative preparation action is certified. The inventory and exit-timing findings come directly from the complete public log.
review.learnings: Reserve mandatory preparation before hunger makes it impossible, but only through an executable, receipt-funded handoff. An exit discovered after starvation does not make unknown drinking safe. Keep mandatory progression pickup and honest unfinished-loot reporting; healing, an incorrect intuition guess and fallback descent are not discovery or collection receipts.
